body: **Foco:** Conditional inversion (Had I known…) — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Expressividade.
**22 palavras novas** (negócios).
**Texto do dia:** editorial / opinião.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar condicionais com if e com inversão (Had, Should, Were) em um editorial sobre inovação.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Editorial: Fund the Risky Idea
paras: **Had** governments **funded** early research on mRNA decades ago, vaccines **might have arrived** sooner. **Should** funders continue to favor safe projects, breakthroughs **will remain** rare. **Were** the system **to reward** curiosity, more discoveries **would follow**.
**If** committees **had been** bolder, we **would be** healthier today. **Had it not been for** a few stubborn scientists, the field **would have vanished**.

items.q: Governments funded mRNA research decades ago.
A few stubborn scientists kept the field alive.

head: Com if
Com inversão (formal)
rows: If governments had funded it, vaccines might have arrived sooner.
**Had governments funded it, vaccines might have arrived sooner.**
If funders continue to favor safe projects,…
**Should funders continue to favor safe projects,…**
If it hadn’t been for scientists,…

blocks.body: A inversão **não muda o sentido**, só o registro. Use em **editoriais, relatórios e discursos**.
Com **were**, o sujeito vem depois: *Were she here,…* (não *If she was here* em registro formal).

items.s: ___ governments funded it earlier, vaccines might have arrived sooner. (Had)
___ funders continue to favor safe projects, breakthroughs will remain rare. (Should)
Were the system ___ reward curiosity, discoveries would follow. (to)
Had it not been ___ stubborn scientists, the field would have vanished. (for)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Take a calculated risk.** — Assumir um risco calculado.
**Pave the way for…** — Abrir caminho para…
**Push the envelope.** — Ir além dos limites.
**Against the odds.** — Contra as probabilidades.
**Pour money into…** — Despejar dinheiro em…
**Play it safe.** — Jogar seguro.
**Back the wrong horse.** — Apostar no cavalo errado.
**Reap the rewards.** — Colher os frutos.
**Had governments funded the research earlier, vaccines might have come sooner.** — Se os governos tivessem financiado antes, as vacinas poderiam ter vindo mais cedo.
**Should funders keep favoring safe projects, breakthroughs will stay rare.** — Se os financiadores continuarem a preferir projetos seguros, os avanços seguirão raros.
**Were the system to reward curiosity, we would see more discoveries.** — Se o sistema recompensasse a curiosidade, veríamos mais descobertas.

blocks.title: Policy debate
lines: Had governments funded the research earlier, vaccines might have come sooner.
Se os governos tivessem financiado antes, as vacinas poderiam ter vindo mais cedo.
Should funders keep favoring safe projects, breakthroughs will stay rare.
Se os financiadores continuarem a preferir projetos seguros, os avanços seguirão raros.
Were the system to reward curiosity, we would see more discoveries.
Se o sistema recompensasse a curiosidade, veríamos mais descobertas.
Had it not been for stubborn scientists, the field would have vanished.
Não fosse por cientistas teimosos, a área teria desaparecido.

items.label: Expressividade
items.note: A expressividade vem de variar altura, volume e velocidade: sobe para entusiasmo, desce para firmeza, pausa antes da ideia importante.

prompts.model: If I had known, I would have called.
If you need help, ask me.
If we were to fail, we would try again.

blocks.task: Rewrite four if-sentences with inversion and add two new ones of your own, on the topic of science funding.
blocks.model: Had governments funded early research, vaccines might have arrived sooner. Should funders keep favoring safe projects, breakthroughs will remain rare. Were the system to reward curiosity, more discoveries would follow. Had committees been bolder, we would be healthier today. Should you doubt this, look at the record. Were I a funder, I would take more risks.
